# simulator.swipe

<div class="api-badges"><span class="api-badge api-badge--new">since 26.2.0</span></div>

Simulate a finger slide on the touchscreen

```lua
simulator.swipe(x1, y1, x2, y2)
```

## Parameters

| Name | Type | Required | Description |
| --- | --- | --- | --- |
| `x1` | integer | yes |  |
| `y1` | integer | yes |  |
| `x2` | integer | yes |  |
| `y2` | integer | yes |  |

## Returns

Nothing.
